game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Sled Run, a steep sled run: the innkeeper must handle ice wolves while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Vault: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the ice mill.
theme: Snowy Hold – Sled Run: a steep sled run
core_gameplay_loop: In Sled Run, repeat each round: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the ice mill. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the vault value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the ice mill using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The ice mill reached with actions_used <= 17.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the ice mill is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 6 (applied tier): Return Vault
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Return Vault' (Week 6 slot 3), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Sled Run'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vault changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice wolves in Sled Run.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The ice mill reached with actions_used <= 17.
